explanation: I used the shared residual-writing directions of the LoRA down_proj and o_proj edits in blocks 9–15 to filter the negative of an analytically estimated gate/up edit shift. The sign comes from the weights alone; the tied embedding readout independently favors words like “consult” and “urgently” over “just,” “only,” and “relax.” I chose layer 13 for the strong agreement across nearby blocks and a norm of 0.70, about 4% of the local residual norm, to keep the intervention modest on general prompts.
